# Loxavo Studios

> Loxavo Studios is an independent iOS app studio that builds premium, offline-first, privacy-respecting apps for iPhone. The studio's apps do not require accounts, do not collect personal data, do not embed ads or third-party trackers, and process data on-device. Current portfolio: VMate Music Player (offline music player) and AI Note Writer: VoiceScribe (offline AI transcription & note-taking).

Loxavo Studios develops two iPhone apps. **VMate Music Player** is a free, offline-first music player with a 10-band equalizer, live lyrics, hi-res audio, folder-based library, instant search, custom playlists and no ads — available in 18 languages. **AI Note Writer: VoiceScribe** is a 100% offline, privacy-first AI note taker that transcribes and summarizes meetings, lectures and calls using on-device AI (WhisperKit), with live transcription, bookmarks, YouTube and document import, an OCR scanner, smart AI templates, interactive AI chat, a voice-typing keyboard, calendar integration and multi-format export (TXT, Markdown, PDF, DOCX, SRT, VTT).

## Apps

### 1. VMate Music Player
- **Category:** Music (iOS / iPhone)
- **Price:** Free, with optional VMate Pro in-app purchases and subscriptions (from $2.99)
- **Rating:** 4.9 / 5 (12,847 ratings), 200,000+ downloads
- **Languages:** 18 (English, Arabic, German, French, Spanish, Italian, Portuguese-Brazil, Dutch, Turkish, Russian, Japanese, Korean, Simplified Chinese, Swedish, Danish, Norwegian, Finnish, Polish)
- **Key features:** Offline playback, 10-band equalizer with bass boost, live synced lyrics, hi-res lossless audio, folder & library browsing, instant search, custom playlists, no ads
- **App Store:** https://apps.apple.com/app/vmate-music-player
- **Website:** https://loxavo.site/#vmate

### 2. AI Note Writer: VoiceScribe
- **Category:** Productivity (iOS / iPhone)
- **Price:** Free, with optional VoiceScribe Pro subscription (from $4.99)
- **Rating:** 4.3 / 5
- **Developer:** Taoufik Bourehouat (Loxavo Studios portfolio)
- **Languages:** 16
- **Key features:** 100% private & offline AI transcription (WhisperKit), live transcription with bookmarks, smart AI templates, interactive AI chat, YouTube & document import, OCR document scanner, voice-typing keyboard, calendar integration (Google & Outlook), multi-format export (TXT, Markdown, PDF, DOCX, SRT, VTT)
- **App Store:** https://apps.apple.com/us/app/ai-note-writer-voicescribe/id6774349229
- **Website:** https://loxavo.site/#voicescribe

## Studio principles
- **Privacy by default:** No accounts, no tracking, no cloud. User data stays on the device.
- **Offline-first:** Every app works without internet — on a plane, underground, anywhere.
- **Premium craft:** Beautiful dark interfaces, smooth animations, thoughtful details.
- **No ads, ever:** In free or paid versions.

## Audience
iPhone owners who want premium, private, ad-free apps — including frequent travellers, audiophiles, students, doctors, lawyers, executives and anyone who values privacy (no tracking, no account required).
